Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about our platform

Getting Started

Click the "Sign Up" button in the top right corner. Fill in your details including name, email, and password. You can choose to register as a student or instructor. Verify your email address to activate your account.

Yes! We offer a 7-day free trial for all new students. During this period, you have full access to all course materials. No credit card is required to start.

Browse our course catalog, select a course you're interested in, and click the "Enroll Now" button. If it's a paid course, you'll be guided through the checkout process.

Absolutely! Our platform is fully responsive and works on all devices. You can learn on your phone, tablet, or desktop - anytime, anywhere.

Account & Billing

We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and in select regions, local payment methods.

Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with a course, you can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase.

Go to your account settings, navigate to the "Billing" section, and you can update your payment method and billing address there.

Yes! Verified students with a valid .edu email address receive a 20% discount on all courses. Contact our support team to verify your student status.

Learning Experience

Courses are divided into modules and lessons. Each lesson includes video content, reading materials, and practical exercises. Many courses also include quizzes and projects.

Yes, most course materials including videos, PDFs, and exercise files can be downloaded for offline access through our mobile app.

Your student dashboard shows your progress for each course, including completed lessons, quiz scores, and overall completion percentage.

Yes! Upon completing a course, you'll receive a verifiable certificate of completion that you can share on LinkedIn or your resume.

For Instructors

Register as an instructor, complete your profile, and submit your first course for review. Our team will review it within 5 business days.

Instructors earn up to 80% revenue share for courses sold through our platform. Higher rates apply for instructor-driven sales.

Payments are processed monthly via PayPal or bank transfer. You need a minimum balance of $50 to receive a payout.

Yes, you can update your course content anytime. Students will be notified of new or updated content.

Technical Support

We support the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. For the best experience, we recommend using Chrome.

Try refreshing the page, checking your internet connection, or clearing your browser cache. If the issue persists, contact our support team.

Click "Forgot Password" on the login page. Enter your email address, and we'll send you a password reset link.
